contact.title_en: AI Robotics Engineer | Robotics Software & Systems Integration

summary.en: AI Robotics Engineer with an M.S. in Electrical Engineering, focused on ROS 2, Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, and Isaac GR00T for robot control, VLA, and Digital Twin data workflows. Experienced in end-to-end integration across perception, data and policy workflows, frontend/backend platforms, and simulation / real-world validation.
summary.zh: AI 機器人工程師，具電機工程碩士背景，專注於 ROS 2、Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab 與 Isaac GR00T 的機器人控制、VLA 與 Digital Twin 資料流程。具備從感知、資料與 Policy 流程、前後端平台到虛擬／真實環境驗證的端到端整合經驗。

experience.company_zh: 瑞軒科技股份有限公司

en: Built ROS 2 control and simulation workflows for industrial and collaborative robot platforms with NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MoveIt 2, and cuMotion for robot control and system validation.
Delivered Isaac GR00T N1.7 data conversion, model training, and policy inference across simulation and physical-robot workflows.
Built an automated workflow and recording platform with Next.js, React Flow, FastAPI, ROS 2, WebSocket, and Docker for AI and robotics data collection.

Owned robotics software from requirements and architecture through Docker deployment, testing, on-site integration, and maintenance; integrated visual perception, robot control, and PatchCore anomaly-detection workflows.
zh: 建置 ROS 2 控制與模擬流程，整合工業／協作型機械手臂平台、NVIDIA Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab、MoveIt 2 與 cuMotion，支援機器人控制與系統驗證。
完成 Isaac GR00T N1.7 資料轉換、模型訓練與 Policy Inference，涵蓋虛擬與真實機器人流程。
以 Next.js、React Flow、FastAPI、ROS 2、WebSocket 與 Docker 建置自動化工作流程與資料錄製平台，支援 AI 與機器人資料流程。
獨立負責機器人軟體從需求、架構到 Docker 部署、測試、現場整合與維護；整合視覺感知、機器人控制與 PatchCore 異常檢測流程。
